block.title: Smoke on push, full checks twice daily
block.p: Main averaged 55 commits per day over the last two complete weeks. Compiler pushes now select 40 default-path smoke steps on one runner, including every program under plain and optimized GC stress. The complete 324-step matrix runs twice daily or on demand. Rocq, Gate, glibc, backend and documentation checks remain narrowly triggered on push.

claim.p: All 40 smoke steps passed on four pinned CPUs in 13 minutes 56 seconds including dependency setup. The complete suite's step definitions are unchanged.

block.p: Site publication builds and uploads on one GitHub runner, without browser gates or artifact handoffs. Browser sweeps, snapshot retention and distribution tests run twice daily. This trades immediate alternate-mode and exhaustive browser feedback for substantially less per-push work; native ABI and GC smoke and the campaign's proof gates stay on push.
